items.passageEn: Our town sits next to a vast forest. For years, the forest was barely known outside the area. Then a massive change happened: a famous movie was filmed there. Mass tourism followed, and now thousands of visitors come every weekend. The town's income has grown, but the volume of trash has grown too. The town now hopes for a reduction in plastic trash, primarily in the forest. New signs show the height of the oldest trees to help visitors enjoy them.
items.passageZh: 我們小鎮就在一大片森林旁。多年來，這座森林在當地以外幾乎沒人知道。後來發生了一個巨大的改變：一部有名的電影在那裡拍攝。大批觀光客隨之而來，現在每個週末都有數千名遊客。小鎮的收入增加了，但垃圾量也增加了。小鎮現在希望減少塑膠垃圾，尤其是森林裡的。新的告示牌標出最老的樹有多高，幫助遊客欣賞。

questions.questionZh: 是什麼讓這座森林出名？
options: 一部有名的電影在那裡拍攝

referenceEn: I barely slept at all last night.
I could barely sleep last night.
rubricZh: barely 表示「幾乎不」，本身已有否定意思，不再加 not
昨晚的事用過去式（例如 slept、could barely sleep）

items.promptZh: 這兩棵樹的高度差不多。
referenceEn: These two trees are about the same height.
The two trees are almost the same height.
rubricZh: 用 height 表示「高度」（例如 the same height；寫 are about as tall as each other 也正確）
「差不多」可寫，例如 about、almost、nearly 等
